name: Flohmarkt am RheinEnergieStadion

organiser.name: Cölln Konzept – Agentur für Veranstaltungen (Bruno Deutzmann)

facts: flea and antiques market several times a year on the forecourt at the back of the RheinEnergieStadion, opposite the Jahnwiese, entrance on Junkersdorfer Straße
antiques and second-hand goods; new goods prohibited
free parking at the Jahnwiese (P5) and on P7
tram 1 to RheinEnergieStadion; buses 141, 143, 144 and 172 to Alter Militärring
notes: Two 2026 dates listed (18 Oct, 6 Dec); 2027 continues with 18 Apr plus planned 14 Mar and 30 May, all outside the window. No visitor opening hours or entry fee given (set-up 06:00–09:00), so opening and fee are null. 'Indoors and outdoors' is read from the stall price line '(drinnen / draußen)'. Organiser page URL is p6.html; the separate 'Flohmarkt P6' (p6_parkplatz.html) has no date before April 2027 and is not included. Coordinates are the Junkersdorfer Straße point from Nominatim, beside the stadium.

description.de: Ein Floh- und Antikmarkt auf dem Vorplatz an der Rückseite des RheinEnergieStadions, gegenüber der Jahnwiese, mehrmals im Jahr. Angeboten werden Antiquitäten und Trödel, Neuware ist verboten; Stände gibt es drinnen und draußen. Parken ist an der Jahnwiese und auf P7 kostenlos, die Linie 1 hält am Stadion.
description.en: A flea and antiques market on the forecourt at the back of the RheinEnergieStadion, opposite the Jahnwiese, held several times a year. Antiques and second-hand goods only, no new stock, with pitches both indoors and outdoors. Parking at the Jahnwiese and on P7 is free, and tram 1 stops at the stadium.
